mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_agent_traces ( conversation_id, turn_id, user_id, user_type, user_query, tool_sequence, thought_summary, approval_audit, attempt_audit, tool_rounds, tool_count, gate_triggered, gate_tool, degraded, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, duration_ms, status, error_msg, create_time ) VALUES ( #{conversationId}, #{turnId}, #{userId}, #{userType}, #{userQuery}, #{toolSequence}, #{thoughtSummary}, #{approvalAudit}, #{attemptAudit}, #{toolRounds}, #{toolCount}, #{gateTriggered}, #{gateTool}, #{degraded}, #{promptTokens}, #{completionTokens}, #{durationMs}, #{status}, #{errorMsg}, #{createTime} )
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_agent_traces SET approval_audit = CASE WHEN approval_audit IS NULL OR approval_audit = '' OR approval_audit = '[]' THEN CONCAT('[', JSON_QUOTE(#{entry}), ']') ELSE CONCAT(SUBSTRING(approval_audit, 1, CHAR_LENGTH(approval_audit) - 1), ',', JSON_QUOTE(#{entry}), ']') END WHERE turn_id = #{turnId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalRuns, COALESCE(SUM(tool_count), 0) AS totalTools, COALESCE(SUM(tool_rounds), 0) AS totalRounds, COALESCE(SUM(gate_triggered), 0) AS gateCount, COALESCE(SUM(degraded), 0) AS degradedCount, COALESCE(SUM(prompt_tokens), 0) AS promptTokens, COALESCE(SUM(completion_tokens), 0) AS completionTokens, COALESCE(AVG(duration_ms), 0) AS avgDurationMs FROM ai_agent_traces
